notes.title: Little Things Update!
notes.notes:
10+ new levels, 2 new achievements and lots of other cool changes!

This update was mostly focused on back-end stuff, so expect a smoother experience, but otherwise roughly the same game.

If you've already played through part of the game, you might find that the level selection screen looks a bit odd. This is normal. 
I added a lot of new levels in between old levels and also moved around preexisting levels to create a more gradual difficulty curve. 
Therefore you'll probably find a bunch of unplayed levels in between your already completed levels. 

Patch notes

 added/modified a lot of levels
 added Lose UI (indicate leftover food/goals)
 added new achievements
 added new main menu
 expanded options
 new save system
 added a way to reset your save from in game
 fixed a bunch of bugs

notes.title: Post Release Fixes!
notes.notes:
This update is mainly just bug fixes with a few UX enhancements thrown in. 
Thank you for your feedback!


 Better level selection. 
- Your last played level will now be selected when returning to level menu.
- When using keyboard/controller level buttons rise, to make your selected level clearer
- You can now scroll the level menu using the right stick
 Save now happens every time you finish a level (crashing won't delete your progress)
 You can now also use 'Space' to go to next level
 Fixed typos
